scope: Robot-only kinematic development screen on all predefined discriminator waypoints
robot_model: robot_kinematics.xml; known Panda, gripper and fixed base calibration only
inputs: current robot joint positions, policy-requested world EEF position/quaternion
selection: Prefer a tolerance-passing solution, then smallest pose residual; log all seed outputs and runtime. No tuning after seeing results.
no_solution_scope: No solution found within this bounded local search; not proof of global unreachability
decision: If known correct poses fail the solver or FK boundary, do not expose it. If solver reports solutions for physically failed motions too, retain as a limited geometric preview, not a motion-success predictor; select a stronger embodiment interface or observation representation before policy evaluation.
